item.title: ‘Really hacked off’: Carse in handcuffs leaves captain Root ‘really disappointed’
item.summary: England captain Joe Root is deeply disappointed by another player's off-field incident. Fast bowler Brydon Carse was seen in handcuffs outside a nightclub early Sunday. This event has prompted an investigation by the England Cricket Regulator. Root stated that these recurring mistakes detract from the team's on-field performance. He acknowledged the need for players to understand their responsibilities away from the game.
